laws.rule: Every trekker on the Kokoda Track needs a Kokoda Track Authority trek permit, PGK 350 for an international trekker (about A$111, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), arranged through a licensed tour operator. Charity fundraising treks pay an extra PGK 2,000 fixed fee.
laws.heading: Kokoda Track Authority, trek permits

sources.title: Trek Permits for the Kokoda Track

local-law.note: The track runs between Central and Oro (Northern) provinces; the same rule is on both.
